description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute, which is responsible for converting relative URIs to absolute URIs within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for preparing configuration, filtering URIs, and resolving path components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter to convert relative URIs to absolute URIs based on a base URI, with internal methods for path resolution.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration, setting the base URI and preparing the path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Converts a given URI to an absolute URI based on the base URI, handling various URI forms and path resolution.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Resolves '.' and '..' segments in a URI path stack to produce a normalized path.
